description:
The modern and stylish accommodation on offer comprises a fantastic open-plan lounge and kitchen dining area, complete with its very own generous-sized private balcony, accessed from both the lounge and the principal bedroom.

The contemporary kitchen is well equipped with a built-in hob, oven, fridge freezer, dishwasher and washing machine, making it both practical and appealing for modern living.

The principal bedroom benefits from a handy built-in wardrobe and is served by a well-fitted bathroom.

This apartment is an ideal first home, while also representing an excellent opportunity for those looking to downsize or for buy-to-let landlords alike. The property is offered with no forward chain and further benefits from an allocated parking space.

Should a purchaser(s) have an offer accepted on a property marketed by Charters Estate Agents, they will need to undertake an identification check. This is done to meet our obligation under Anti Money Laundering Regulations (AML) and is a legal requirement. We use a specialist third party service to verify your identity. The cost of these checks is £60 inc. VAT per purchaser, which is paid in advance, when an offer is agreed and prior to a sales memorandum being issued. This charge is non-refundable under any circumstances.

Telephone House is ideally situated in the heart of Southampton City Centre on the historic High Street, offering excellent access to a wide range of shops, restaurants, cafés and leisure facilities. Westquay Shopping Centre, Ocean Village Marina and Mayflower Park are all within easy walking distance. Southampton Central railway station and the M3/M27 motorway networks are also conveniently accessible, making this an ideal location for city living and commuting alike.
